$comment: Scout (Flow 0) column-definition array for List A = 'Inbox Action Register'. Generated from Phase U frozen taxonomy v4 (2026-07-03). The flow's Apply-to-each loops over .columns and creates each field via _api/web/lists/getbytitle('Inbox Action Register')/fields/CreateFieldAsXml (recommended) or a typed JSON POST to .../fields. See scout_listA_columns_README.md for endpoints, the SchemaXml renderer, and caveats. FieldTypeKind: Text=2, Note=3, DateTime=4, Choice=6, Boolean=8, Number=9, Currency=10, URL=11, MultiChoice=15, Calculated=17.

titleRename.note: Scout step 4: PATCH the built-in Title field's Title property to 'Email Subject' (do NOT create a new field). Endpoint: POST _api/web/lists/getbytitle('Inbox Action Register')/fields/getbytitle('Title') with X-HTTP-Method=MERGE, body {"__metadata":{"type":"SP.FieldText"},"Title":"Email Subject"}.

columns.description: When the email arrived. Basis for Days Since Received and default follow-up windows (spec 1a).
From address.
Domain of sender; supports sender-cluster reporting. NOTE (R1): domain informs Source System, never Business Category.
Supports R4 (direct-to-Gina outranks list) and R6 owner inference.
Pilot = Primary only (no shared mailboxes, per Gina 2026-07-03). fillInChoice true so shared mailboxes can be added later without schema change.

R1 KEYSTONE FIELD: the originating platform lives HERE, not in Business Category. This is what lets Gina keep her 'by Smartsheet/NetSuite' view without polluting the category. fillInChoice true for new systems.
18 frozen categories (SMARTSHEET retired per R1). Classify by content, never by sender system. Names use an en-dash (–).
7 frozen lanes. Ministry/Community is new (R5). Lane often driven by R6 owner-vs-informed: informed copies -> FYI regardless of content.
BSSI pillar (spec 8). Classifier sets it; content-judged for the 5 ambiguous categories, default map for the rest.
R6 (richest Phase U finding). 'Me' -> action lane + follow-up clock; 'Someone Else'/'None' -> FYI/Reference lane even if content is actionable.
Person who owns the next step (name or email). Consider converting to a Person/Group field post-pilot; kept Text for self-service provisioning simplicity.
Who we're waiting on (Waiting lane). Watchdog nudge target (spec 1b).
Drives default follow-up window (spec 1a) and escalation (1b).
Sweep (Flow 8) fires on Done/Reference; Snoozed re-evaluates via Watchdog.
A due date explicitly stated in the email (overrides default window in 1a). Blank -> Tempo applies default.
Tempo (Flow 5a) writes this from the 1a table if blank.
Reset on every status touch. Waiting-lane clock and 30-day stale rule (1b) key off this, not Received Date.

Spec 1a. CAVEAT: SharePoint calculated columns using TODAY() do NOT auto-refresh daily (only on item edit). Watchdog (Flow 6, daily) should compute true aging in-flow or restamp; treat this column as display-only. See README.
Needs-Review disposition (confirmed 2026-07-03). Ambiguous action-vs-FYI items stay Reviewed=No and surface in the 'Stale – Review to Close' / Needs Review view until a human confirms.
Escalation sets 'Today' (spec 1b).
Quill sets 'Draft Ready'; human sets 'Approved to Send'; Courier sets 'Sent' -> Status auto-flips Done (1b). No-auto-send gate.
Classifier confidence 0-100. Feeds Confidence Band.
Buckets Confidence. Low-band rows are review candidates.
Priority/system-exception trigger phrases matched (Deliverable 3). Audit trail for why priority/lane was set.
Graph message id. Sweep (Flow 8) looks up the email by this; if not found it writes to Notes rather than erroring (spec 4 edge case).
OWA deep link to the message.
True if the source email had attachments.
One-line why for content-judged Pillar assignments (the 5 ambiguous categories in spec 8).
When Sorter/Echo classified the row.
Free text. Sweep writes 'original email not found – may have been moved manually' here on lookup failure (spec 4).
